model_output.rationale: CO-16 paired with RARC N286 identifies a missing/invalid referring provider NPI, per reference 09. Claim adjudicated (835 has payer claim control 2626660924906), so this is a data-defect denial requiring correction and resubmission to Novitas, not an appeal or patient bill.

root_cause.explanation: All 4 lines denied CO-16 with claim-level MOA N286 (missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier); no referring provider NPI appears anywhere on the 837P claim.

next_action.detail: Add valid referring/ordering provider name and NPI (verified in NPI Registry/PECOS) to the claim. Medicare Part B FFS accepts only CLM05-3=1 (frequency 7 rejected); since this claim was adjudicated (CLP07 present), submit via clerical-error reopening to Novitas rather than a fresh original if reopening is available.

evidence.fact: Claim-level MOA N286 and line-level CO-16 on all 4 service lines; payer claim control number 2626660924906 present, status 4 (denied)
No referring/ordering provider loop present on the claim; only billing, rendering, and subscriber parties listed
CARC 16 + RARC N286 = missing/invalid referring provider primary identifier; disposition correct_and_resubmit, group CO never billable to patient

citations.rule: CO-16 + N286 identifies missing/invalid referring provider NPI; correct_and_resubmit, never appeal, never bill patient
Medicare Part B/DME FFS does not accept frequency 7; use reopening or new original depending on adjudication status
